chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Zurārah, who said:
“It is only disliked for a man to combine two sets of seven circuits and two tawafs in the obligatory rite. As for the voluntary one, there is no problem.”

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or objection
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: is considered disliked in legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to combine two tawafs in obligatory and voluntary tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tawaf in hajj or ʿumrah rites. It states that combining two tawafs together is disliked in an obligatory tawaf, while there is no objection to doing so in a supererogatory tawaf.
